review_type: candidate product-definition review, not a freeze or implementation review

facts_checked.criterion: Person is the overall product subject; work/Project is one context rather than the global product center
facts_checked.observed: The P3-113 candidate defines Person's today as the home focus and binds work as a source-visible domain context.

facts_checked.criterion: The historical project-recovery baseline remains an input and is not rewritten, unfrozen or misrepresented as the new final baseline
facts_checked.observed: P1-001/P1-003/P1-004/P1-006/P1-016 remain historical constraints; P3-113 describes a candidate rebaseline only.

facts_checked.criterion: The proposed minimal loop is concrete without claiming a shipped product
facts_checked.observed: The combined initial and Rework 1 package supplies source binding, current understanding, one conditional question, 1-3 advice items, feedback, execution/result and a blocked memory candidate.

facts_checked.criterion: The candidate does not turn historical P3-111/P3-112 engineering evidence into product value, real capability or Stage 4 evidence
facts_checked.observed: Gate 4 stays conditional and Gate 5 remains a falsifiable hypothesis; no real data, model call or user-value result is asserted.

independent_judgment: The composite candidate is a bounded Person-first product rebaseline that preserves the prior work-domain baseline as history. It is sufficiently explicit for review but remains unfrozen candidate input.
